detail.longDescription: Peppermint OS Void (PepVoid) is announced. It adds Void Linux as another base next to Debian and Devuan, not a rebase. • Rolling release, no version number • XFCE with XLibre, Loaded ISO (~4 GB) • New Peppermint Software Center • Custom Python ISO builder Check the signature with the Void key, not the Devuan one: https://www. opensourcefeed.org/peppermint- os-void-edition-release/ # PeppermintOS # VoidLinux # Linux # FOSS # OpenSource
